text:
[TRV-C01] Purpose and Scope
This policy establishes corporate travel guidelines for all Asterline Services Group personnel undertaking authorized business travel between January 1, 2026 and June 30, 2026. All business travel must be directly related to active commercial operations and approved in advance.
title: Travel Policy v1

text:
[TRV-C02] Air Travel Standards
Domestic air travel must be booked in economy class. International flights exceeding eight continuous flight hours are eligible for premium economy class subject to prior written recommendation from the reporting manager.
title: Travel Policy v1

text:
[TRV-C03] Lodging and Meals
Standard hotel accommodations are capped at INR 6,000 per night in metropolitan cities and INR 4,000 in regional locations. Daily meal subsistence allowance is capped at INR 1,500 per diem with itemized receipts.
title: Travel Policy v1

text:
[TRV-C04] Travel Expense Approval Thresholds
Travel expenses up to and including INR 40,000 follow standard approval by the direct reporting manager. Any travel expenses exceeding INR 40,000 require additional approval from the department director prior to reimbursement.
title: Travel Policy v1

text:
[TRV-C05] Non-Reimbursable Disallowances
Personal entertainment, alcoholic beverages, hotel minibar charges, traffic citations, late check-out fees, and flight upgrades purchased independently will not be reimbursed by Asterline Services Group.
title: Travel Policy v1

text:
[TRV-C01] Purpose and Scope
This revised policy establishes updated corporate travel guidelines for all Asterline Services Group personnel undertaking authorized business travel from July 1, 2026 onward. This document formally supersedes Travel Policy v1.
title: Travel Policy v2

text:
[TRV-C02] Air Travel Standards
Domestic air travel must be booked in economy class. International flights exceeding eight continuous flight hours are eligible for premium economy class subject to prior written recommendation from the reporting manager.
title: Travel Policy v2

text:
[TRV-C03] Lodging and Meals
Standard hotel accommodations are capped at INR 7,500 per night in metropolitan cities and INR 5,000 in regional locations. Daily meal subsistence allowance is capped at INR 2,000 per diem with itemized receipts.
title: Travel Policy v2

text:
[TRV-C04] Travel Expense Approval Thresholds
Travel expenses up to and including INR 50,000 follow standard approval by the direct reporting manager. Any travel expenses exceeding INR 50,000 require additional approval from the department director prior to reimbursement.
title: Travel Policy v2

text:
[TRV-C05] Non-Reimbursable Disallowances
Personal entertainment, alcoholic beverages, hotel minibar charges, traffic citations, late check-out fees, and flight upgrades purchased independently will not be reimbursed by Asterline Services Group.
title: Travel Policy v2

text:
[TRV-B01] Central Travel Portal
All employee airline, railway, and hotel reservations must be booked exclusively through the designated Asterline Travel Portal. Direct personal bookings on commercial third-party websites are non-reimbursable.
title: Travel Booking

text:
[TRV-B02] Advance Booking Window
Domestic flight bookings must be made at least 14 days in advance of departure to secure corporate discounted fares. Bookings made fewer than 14 days before departure require expedited approval from the functional manager.
title: Travel Booking

text:
[TRV-B03] Cancellations and Rescheduling
Ticket cancellations or travel date modifications must be logged in the travel portal within 24 hours of itinerary change notification to minimize carrier penalty fees.
title: Travel Booking

text:
[TRV-E01] Travel Exception Approval Route
When extraordinary business exigencies require exceeding standard travel caps, exception amounts up to and including INR 100,000 require approval from the Department Vice President. Exception amounts exceeding INR 100,000 require approval from the Chief Financial Officer.
title: Travel Exceptions

text:
[TRV-E02] Emergency Client Deployments
Urgent customer-site deployments requested on less than 48 hours notice are exempt from advance booking windows upon simultaneous notification to Finance Operations.
title: Travel Exceptions

text:
[TRV-E03] Medical Accommodations
Medical accommodation requests requiring specialized seating or accommodations must be certified by People Operations and approved for enhanced travel allowance.
title: Travel Exceptions

text:
[FIN-C01] General Claim Eligibility
Employees incurring out-of-pocket expenses while conducting authorized company duties are entitled to full reimbursement upon submitting verified expense vouchers.
title: Expense Claims

text:
[FIN-C02] Claim Submission Window
Expense claims submitted within 30 days of expense incurrence are processed under regular reimbursement timelines. Claims submitted after 30 days require a late submission justification approved by Finance Operations.
title: Expense Claims

text:
[FIN-C03] Manager Verification SLA
Supervising managers must inspect supporting vouchers and approve or return subordinate claims within five working days of submission.
title: Expense Claims

text:
[FIN-R01] Payment Cycles
Approved claims are disbursed twice monthly via direct bank deposit on the 15th and the final business day of each calendar month.
title: Reimbursements

text:
[FIN-R02] Foreign Currency Claims
International expenditures are settled in Indian Rupees using the official Reserve Bank of India reference rate published on the date of transaction.
title: Reimbursements

text:
[FIN-R03] Receipt Verification Threshold
Incidental business expenses up to and including INR 1,000 do not require an itemized tax receipt provided digital payment confirmation is attached. Incidental expenses exceeding INR 1,000 strictly require an itemized tax invoice.
title: Reimbursements

text:
[FIN-K01] Card Issuance Criteria
Corporate credit cards are issued to designated managers and frequent business travelers following authorization by the Finance Controller.
title: Corporate Cards

text:
[FIN-K02] Monthly Spend Limit
Corporate cardholders are allocated a standard monthly spending limit of INR 200,000. Monthly spending exceeding INR 200,000 requires card limit escalation and formal credit extension approved by Finance Operations.
title: Corporate Cards

text:
[FIN-K03] Statement Reconciliation
Cardholders must submit expense reconciliations and itemized receipts within ten business days of monthly billing cycle statement generation.
title: Corporate Cards

text:
[FIN-A01] Random Audit Sampling
Internal Audit performs regular monthly audits sampling a minimum of 10 percent of all settled employee expense reimbursement claims.
title: Expense Audits

text:
[FIN-A02] Discrepancy Investigation
Suspected duplicate vouchers, inflated receipts, or unauthorized purchases trigger immediate claim freezing and formal referral to the Internal Audit Committee.
title: Expense Audits

text:
[FIN-A03] Audit Trail Retention
All financial audit working papers, sampling logs, and investigation findings must be archived in tamper-evident storage for seven fiscal years.
title: Expense Audits

text:
[PPO-L01] Annual Leave Entitlement
Full-time employees accrue 20 working days of paid annual vacation per year, credited pro-rata at the rate of 1.67 days per completed calendar month.
title: Leave Policy

text:
[PPO-L02] Sick Leave Certification
Employees taking up to and including 3 consecutive sick leave days may submit self-certification upon return to work. Consecutive sick leave exceeding 3 days requires a medical certificate issued by a registered medical practitioner.
title: Leave Policy

text:
[PPO-L03] Parental Leave Provisions
Eligible primary caregivers receive 26 continuous weeks of fully paid maternity leave. Secondary caregivers receive 4 weeks of fully paid paternity leave.
title: Leave Policy

text:
[PPO-R01] Remote Work Eligibility
Employees having completed their initial three-month probationary evaluation with satisfactory performance may request up to three remote work days per week.
title: Remote Work

text:
[PPO-R02] Network Speed Standard
Remote personnel must maintain broadband internet connectivity with at least 50 mbps download bandwidth. Internet speeds below 50 mbps require connection remediation before remote work authorization is granted.
title: Remote Work

text:
[PPO-R03] Core Availability Window
Remote employees must remain accessible via company chat and video conferencing during core business hours between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM local time.
title: Remote Work

text:
[PPO-B01] Tuition Assistance Scope
Permanent employees with at least six months of continuous service are eligible to claim tuition assistance for accredited job-relevant degree or certification courses.
title: Learning Benefits

text:
[PPO-B02] Annual Learning Allowance
Annual educational assistance up to and including INR 75,000 is granted under standard reporting manager approval. Educational assistance claims exceeding INR 75,000 require review and approval from the People Operations Learning Committee.
title: Learning Benefits

text:
[PPO-B03] Completion Verification
Reimbursement disbursement requires submitting an official passing grade transcript or certificate of completion within 45 days of course conclusion.
title: Learning Benefits

text:
[PPO-T01] Internal Mobility Tenancy
Employees must complete a minimum tenure of twelve consecutive months in their current role with satisfactory performance before applying for internal transfers.
title: Employee Transfers

text:
[PPO-T02] Transfer Authorization Chain
Internal transfers require written agreement from the releasing department head, the acquiring department head, and People Operations HR Business Partner.
title: Employee Transfers

text:
[PPO-T03] Transition Handover Period
The releasing department may retain the transferring employee for a handover transition period not exceeding thirty calendar days from offer acceptance.
title: Employee Transfers

text:
[PRC-P01] Purchase Requisition Origination
All commercial purchases of hardware, software, licenses, or professional services must originate as an approved electronic Purchase Requisition in the enterprise ERP.
title: Purchase Requests

text:
[PRC-P02] Competitive Bidding Threshold
Purchase orders up to and including INR 150,000 may be processed with a single qualified vendor quote. Purchase orders exceeding INR 150,000 strictly require at least three independent competitive bids submitted to Procurement.
title: Purchase Requests

text:
[PRC-P03] Standard Delivery Terms
All purchase orders must incorporate standard commercial freight terms and a minimum 30-day inspection warranty period from receipt.
title: Purchase Requests

text:
[PRC-V01] Vendor Due Diligence
Prospective suppliers must undergo statutory due diligence including corporate registration validation, tax compliance certificates, and credit screening.
title: Vendor Onboarding

text:
[PRC-V02] Security Risk Assessment
Vendors handling proprietary company data or connecting to internal systems must complete an Information Security Supplier Assessment prior to contract signing.
title: Vendor Onboarding

text:
[PRC-V03] Ethics and Compliance Code
All onboarded suppliers must execute the Asterline Supplier Code of Conduct affirming strict compliance with anti-bribery and fair labor regulations.
title: Vendor Onboarding

text:
[PRC-C01] Signatory Authority
Commercial contracts may only be entered into by designated corporate signatories defined in the corporate Delegation of Authority matrix.
title: Contract Approval

text:
[PRC-C02] Contract Term Sign-Off Authority
Vendor contracts with duration up to and including 12 months require approval by the Department Functional Lead. Vendor contracts with duration exceeding 12 months require joint sign-off from Legal Counsel and Procurement.
title: Contract Approval

text:
[PRC-C03] Liability Limitation
Standard master service agreements must cap mutual commercial liability at twelve months of fees, unless an explicit waiver is granted by Legal Counsel.
title: Contract Approval

text:
[PRC-E01] Emergency Procurement Cap
In critical operational emergencies impacting business continuity, emergency purchases up to and including INR 300,000 may proceed under Director emergency approval. Emergency purchases exceeding INR 300,000 require authorization from the Board Procurement Committee.
title: Purchase Exceptions

text:
[PRC-E02] Sole Source Justification
Procurement without competitive bidding requires an authenticated Sole Source Justification detailing proprietary technical exclusivity or market absence of alternatives.
title: Purchase Exceptions

text:
[PRC-E03] Emergency Ratification
All emergency purchase orders must be formally submitted for retroactive documentation and invoice ratification within ten business days of issuance.
title: Purchase Exceptions

text:
[SEC-D01] Classification Tiers
All Asterline digital and physical information assets are classified into four tiers: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted based on business impact.
title: Data Classification

text:
[SEC-D02] Tier Encryption Standards
Data classified as Confidential requires mandatory AES-256 encryption at rest and in transit. Data classified as Restricted requires hardware security module tokenized encryption and dual authorization for access.
title: Data Classification

text:
[SEC-D03] Handling and Labeling
Confidential and Restricted documents must bear prominent visual classification headers and may not be transferred outside authorized networks without security approval.
title: Data Classification

text:
[SEC-A01] Least Privilege Principle
User accounts are provisioned solely with access permissions necessary to fulfill designated job responsibilities following the principle of least privilege.
title: Access Requests

text:
[SEC-A02] Privileged Role Review Frequency
Privileged and administrative access rights must undergo recertification review at intervals up to and including 90 days. Privileged accounts exceeding 90 days without recertification are subject to automatic account suspension.
title: Access Requests

text:
[SEC-A03] Role Separation
Personnel assigned code development duties may not hold administrative deployment permissions on production databases without a temporary break-glass waiver.
title: Access Requests

text:
[SEC-I01] Security Incident Severity
Security incidents are triaged into Priority 1 (Critical), Priority 2 (Major), Priority 3 (Moderate), and Priority 4 (Minor) according to system impact.
title: Incident Reporting

text:
[SEC-I02] Priority 1 Response SLA
Priority 1 critical incidents involving confirmed system compromise must be responded to and contained within 1 hour of alert generation. Response times exceeding 1 hour require immediate SLA breach escalation to executive leadership.
title: Incident Reporting

text:
[SEC-I03] Incident Post-Mortem
A comprehensive post-incident analysis and remediation report must be published to the Chief Information Security Officer within 72 hours of incident closure.
title: Incident Reporting

text:
[SEC-R01] Statutory Retention Periods
Employee payroll and financial ledger records must be preserved for seven calendar years. Customer audit logs and connection telemetries are retained for two years.
title: Data Retention

text:
[SEC-R02] Sanitization and Disposal
Decommissioned storage drives must be purged in compliance with NIST SP 800-88 standards or physically degaussed before disposal.
title: Data Retention

text:
[SEC-R03] Litigation Hold Protocol
Information assets associated with active or anticipated legal disputes must be placed on litigation hold and exempted from automated retention disposal.
title: Data Retention
